 Grizzlies vs Trail Blazers | Thursday, Oct 29, 2026 at 10:00 pm ET | Moda Center, Portland, OR | League Pass 
 The NBA is back in action with only three games tonight, but the Grizzlies and the Trail Blazers might be one of the more exciting games on the schedule. Both teams have had a hot start to the season, and this is the first time the two teams have faced each other since Ja Morant switched sides in the battle. 
 Memphis comes into this game with a perfect record and hopes of returning to the postseason this year. They haven’t had to face anyone that is all that great yet, but that’s not their fault. They beat the Jazz in their first game with ease. Then they took down the Warriors by three points in their second game. They beat the Kings by 11, and then they beat the Jazz by five in their last game. Cam Boozer is averaging a double-double, but the true turnaround of this season has been Ty Jerome, averaging almost 30 points per game. 
 The Trail Blazers are returning home after taking on the Lakers on Tuesday night. In that game, Portland racked up 136 points with six different players scoring in double figures. Their other two games saw them destroy Phoenix on opening night, their lone home game of the season. In their next game, they faced the Kings and beat them by eight points. It may take a while for Portland to figure out the balance of their roster, but for now, Damian Lillard and Deni Avdija are leading the way. 
 Which of these teams will win this battle between the Grizzlies and Trail Blazers? Wager on your choice at Underdog, with a $10 wager giving you $50 in bonus bets when using promo code FOXNEWS.
